name: Saaya
source:
A tropical half-breed with a brown and seductive body. She is a bright girl that is seen as a goddess. She breeds eroticism, but she strongly believes in love and chastity. She dislike men who are solely interested in her body.

She is close friends with Kirari. She tries to scold her for being involved with the protagonist but...
